in_arabic.name: جمالون
in_arabic.meaning: جمالون يعني الجمال الكثير والخُلد في الجنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جمالون هو اسم مشتق من الجمال والخُلد، ويشير إلى الجمال الكثير الذي يتمتع به الشخص في الحياة الدنيا والآخرة، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير أنه يعني الخُلد في الجنة مع الجمال

in_urdu.name: جمالون
in_urdu.meaning: جمالون کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور جنت میں الخلد
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمالون ایک عربی نام ہے جو جمال اور خلد سے ماخوذ ہے، یہ نام خوبصورتی اور جنت میں الخلد کی علامت ہے، جنوبی ایشیاء کے مسلم معاشرے میں اس نام کی برکت اور خوبی کے معانی ہیں

in_hindi.name: जमालोन
in_hindi.meaning: जमालोन का अर्थ है सुंदरता और स्वर्ग में अमरत्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: जमालोन एक अरबी नाम है जो जمال और अमरत्व से लिया गया है, यह नाम सुंदरता और स्वर्ग में अमरत्व का प्रतीक है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम की विशेष महत्वता और पवित्रता के अर्थ हैं

in_pashto.name: جمالون
in_pashto.meaning: جمالون د ښکلا او جنت کی معنی ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: جمالون د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د جمال او خلد څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دا نوم د ښکلا او جنت کی علامه ده، په افغان او پښتني دودیزو کې دا نوم د پخوا له خاصه معنی او ارزښت څخه برخمن دی

in_english.name: Jamāilaun
in_english.meaning: Jamāilaun means beauty and eternity in paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Jamāilaun is derived from Arabic roots 'jamal' meaning beauty and 'lun' suggesting eternity. It signifies abundant beauty and eternal bliss in paradise. This name has historical significance in Islamic tradition and symbolizes spiritual beauty and everlasting joy

data.cultural_impact: The name Jamāilaun is often associated with beauty, grace, and elegance in Islamic culture. It is a name that connotes the best of feminine qualities and is often given to girls born into families who place a high premium on physical and moral beauty. In some communities, women named Jamāilaun are considered to be blessed with a special kind of radiance and charm that attracts attention and admiration.
data.spiritual_significance: However, the spiritual significance of the name Jamāilaun goes beyond physical beauty and is rooted in the Islamic teachings about the inner beauty of the soul. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Allah is beautiful, and He loves beauty." (Bukhari and Muslim). Therefore, having a beautiful name like Jamāilaun is a constant reminder for the bearer to strive towards inner and moral beauty, which is pleasing to Allah. It is a reminder to be kind, compassionate, generous, and forgiving, as these are the qualities that truly make a person beautiful in the eyes of Allah. In essence, the name Jamāilaun is a call to be not only physically beautiful but also morally beautiful, which is the true mark of a noble character and a pleasing servant of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Beautiful woman" symbolizes The one with the beautiful face. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Jamāilaun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of beautiful woman.
